description: Complete 120-slot TKB UK vehicle fleet, rebuilt with transparent 110×110 graphics. Every slot includes a normal PNG and an animated response APNG. Flashing lights are aligned to each vehicle’s lamp sections. All pods are mounted on complete carrier vehicles, and trailer graphics include connected towing vehicles. Four helicopters feature eight-frame main- and tail-rotor animations with fixed hubs and flashing beacons (65 ms per frame). The other 116 response animations use two frames at 260 ms per frame. Includes Coastguard Drone Unit, Lifeguard Quadbike and Lifeguard 4x4. Artwork by TKB Gaming; no official service affiliation.
